entities.summary: Tian Tao (b. 1994-04-08, Changyang Tujia Autonomous County) was a athlete or sports figure of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Changyang Tujia Autonomous County and China. Known in the fields of china, athletes & competitors, asia.
